description.narrative: The provision of senior debt financing for the design, construction, outfitting and maintenance of a 630-bed multidisciplinary hospital in Kokshetau, Kazakhstan (the "Project") to be undertaken by Renell Kokshetau LLP (the "Project Company") under a 7-year public private partnership (PPP) contract signed with the Republic of Kazakhstan on 22 December 2022. The Project aims to (i) replace obsolete hospital infrastructure and medical equipment in Kokshetau; (ii) support delivery of seamless healthcare experience and increase the availability and quality of medical services provided; (iii) create new workplaces during both the Project's construction and operation phases; and (iv) have a positive multiplicative effect on the economy through a better healthcare provision.
